# American Legacy Contracting

> Licensed general contractor in Utah County, Utah. Specializing in basement finishing, kitchen and bathroom remodels, new construction, and handyman services. Serving 17 cities across Utah County.

Website: https://americanlegacycontracting.com
Full details for LLMs: https://americanlegacycontracting.com/llms-full.txt

## About

Alan Barben is the owner and operator of American Legacy Contracting, based in Payson, Utah. He personally manages every project — no sales reps, no project managers, just Alan. He holds a Bachelor's degree and an Applied Science degree in Construction Management, is fully licensed and insured in Utah, and has 14+ years of experience across residential and commercial construction including framing, electrical, HVAC, and plumbing. BuildZoom ranks American Legacy Contracting in the top 1% of general contractors in Utah, above 74,376 other contractors.

## Services

- **Basement Finishing** — turning unfinished basements into livable space (bedrooms, family rooms, home offices, theaters, gyms). Costs typically $25-50/sq ft. https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/basement-finishing/
- **Kitchen & Bathroom Remodels** — full renovations including cabinets, countertops, tile, plumbing, electrical, and layout changes. https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/kitchen-bathroom-remodels/
- **New Construction** — custom homes, spec homes, home additions, ADUs, and mother-in-law suites. https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/new-construction/
- **Handyman Services** — drywall repair, door installation, fencing, decks, tile repair, painting, shelving, trim, and general home repairs. Also coordinates licensed electricians and plumbers. https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/handyman-services/

## Service Area (17 Cities)

Lehi, American Fork, Highland, Alpine, Cedar Hills, Pleasant Grove, Lindon, Orem, Provo, Springville, Spanish Fork, Mapleton, Salem, Elk Ridge, Payson, Santaquin, and Nephi — all in Utah County, Utah.

Each city has a dedicated page: https://americanlegacycontracting.com/service-areas/[city-slug]/
